text: the object {id} has a written rich-text field {name}, and the space it moves to already holds the object, so its document cannot be moved there yet
when: Space::move_objects (space.move) when an object with a written rich-text field moves into a space whose copy already holds the object, such as a move back: re-creating the document there would show its text twice, and how it moves back is open (NOC-539; owner question NOC-560).
